run_simclr_training: run the SimCLR training pipeline with command line arguments via main(params)
build_simclr_game: build a SimCLR game with a vision encoder, batch size, and NT-Xent loss temperature
create_dataloader: create a distributed data loader for a dataset with configurable image size and batch size
configure_larc_optimizer: configure a LARC optimizer wrapper around SGD with trust coefficient and epsilon settings
add_weight_decay: add weight decay to model parameters while skipping batch normalization layers
